    longitude_2: float, loxodromic: bool=True) ->float:
    if loxodromic:
        # Loxodromic (rhumb line) course
        lat1 = mod_math.radians(latitude_1)
        lat2 = mod_math.radians(latitude_2)
        d_lon = mod_math.radians(longitude_2 - longitude_1)
        
        # Handle longitude wraparound
        if d_lon > mod_math.pi:
            d_lon -= 2 * mod_math.pi
        elif d_lon < -mod_math.pi:
            d_lon += 2 * mod_math.pi
            
        d_lat = lat2 - lat1
        
        if abs(d_lat) < 1e-10:
            # Points have same latitude
            course = 0.0 if d_lon >= 0 else 180.0
        else:
            # Calculate course using atan2
            course = mod_math.degrees(mod_math.atan2(d_lon, d_lat))
            
        return (course + 360) % 360
    else:
        # Orthodromic (great circle) course

        d_lon = mod_math.radians(longitude_2 - longitude_1)

        x = mod_math.cos(lat1) * mod_math.sin(lat2) - mod_math.sin(lat1) * mod_math.cos(lat2) * mod_math.cos(d_lon)
